note: Single source of truth for enhancements. Rendered on enhancements.html and guidebook.html, and bundled into the checkout worker (worker/) so prices can never be tampered with client-side. Prices are USD cents; price null = market price / call to arrange.

items.name: Early Check-In (arrive from 1:00 PM)
items.desc: Check in as early as 1:00 PM instead of our regular 3:00 PM check-in time. Advance notice required so our cleaning crew can have your cabin ready.

items.name: Veuve Clicquot
items.desc: Yellow Label Champagne Brut 750mL.

items.name: Louis Bouillot Cremant de Bourgogne Brut
items.desc: Burgundy, France — Complex nose of fresh orange, apples and cherry skins with thyme and violets. Delicate, long finish.

items.name: Decoy by Duckhorn Cabernet
items.desc: California — From its deep, inviting color to its enticing layers of boysenberry, blackberry, plum and star anise, this wine showcases great Sonoma County Cabernet Sauvignon. Lush fruit flavors framed by rich tannins and hints of dark chocolate and barrel spice.

items.name: Decoy by Duckhorn Merlot
items.desc: Sonoma County, CA — A lovely Merlot with aromas of plum, cedar, and notes of baking spices. Layers of fresh strawberries and raspberries saturate the palate. Soft, smooth finish with well-integrated tannins.

items.name: Harvester Cabernet Sauvignon
items.desc: Paso Robles — Full-bodied with red berries, spice, and velvety tannins. Crafted by Austin Hope of Hope Family Wines.

items.name: Caliveda Pinot Noir, 2022
items.desc: California — Juicy black cherry and pomegranate cola with an enticing vanilla note.

items.name: Josh Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon
items.desc: California — Aromas of ripe black currant, smoke and saddle. Flavors of dark cherry and ripe plum with a hint of vanilla and cocoa. A firm, approachable structure with a balanced, long finish.

items.name: Apothic Red
items.desc: California — Intense fruit aromas and flavors of rhubarb and black cherry complemented by hints of mocha and vanilla. Plush, velvety mouthfeel and smooth finish round out this full-bodied red blend.

items.name: Chateau d'Esclans Whispering Angel Rose
items.desc: Cotes de Provence, France — Full of mouthwatering flavor with a lovely texture. Lots of light fruit flavors with a clean finish, this wine demonstrates the power of its grape.

items.name: Miraval Cotes de Provence Rose
items.desc: Cotes de Provence, France — Vibrant acidity pulses beneath juicy notes of peach and watermelon, plus herb accents.

items.name: Santa Margherita Pinot Grigio
items.desc: Alto Adige, Italy — A dry white wine with a straw yellow color. Clean, intense aroma and bone-dry taste with an appealing flavor of Golden Delicious apples make this a wine of great personality and versatility.

items.name: Sonoma-Cutrer Chardonnay
items.desc: Russian River Valley, Sonoma, CA — From the Cutrer vineyard less than fifteen miles from the Pacific Ocean, this full-bodied wine displays notes of citrus, tropical fruits, and hazelnuts. Creamy texture followed by a long, minerally finish.

items.name: Jadot Macon Villages
items.desc: Macon-Villages, Burgundy, France — A fresh, brilliant pale-gold Chardonnay with delicate varietal aromas, flavors of apple and melon offset by citrus notes, and a crisp acidic balance ending in a clean, lively finish.

items.name: Whitehaven Sauvignon Blanc
items.desc: A delicious mix of passion fruit, guava, mango and dried pineapple flavors, with notes of crunchy sea salt, lemon and orange blossoms, neroli orange, and wild fennel on the mouthwatering, fresh frame.

items.name: Governors Bay Sauvignon Blanc
items.desc: New Zealand — Intense gooseberry, passionfruit, capsicum with a hint of melon. Fresh and crisp.

items.name: Kim Crawford Sauvignon Blanc
items.desc: Marlborough, New Zealand — A bouquet of citrus and tropical fruits backed by characteristic herbaceous notes. Exuberant flavors of pineapple and stone fruit with a hint of herbaceousness on the palate. Finish is fresh and zesty.

A crock of hot apple cider waiting just for you, extra plush faux fur blankets, and the perfect setting to reconnect & relax. Available for arrival day only.
